basic_info.description: Built in 2014, this stunning two-story, top floor view, 1790 sqft house like condo with many fabulous upgrades is situated in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods, it offers breathtaking views of the San Francisco Golf Club. The contemporary design features a beautifully designed open floor plan & offers indoor-outdoor living at its best with large walk out view decks from both floors. The welcoming living room opens flawlessly into the kitchen & dining area, the state of the art kitchen is amazing w/ large island with seating & top of the line Viking appliances. The dining area can seat 10 and is enhanced with custom built In cabinets. A powder room complete this level. Upstairs, 3 bdrms and 2 baths include a luxurious primary view suite with seating area and large walk-in closet. It features custom-built nightstands with  designer lamps, a wood accent wall, & king-sized headboard. Additional highlights include a laundry closet, two-car parking &solar panels. 800 Summit offers exclusive amenities, incl a dog park, playground, & a two-acre park. Close to Lake Merced ,shopping, transportation & and world renowned golf courses & top-rated schools including Chinese American International, Lowell High, & St. Ignatius. Minutes from West Portal Village, & Stonestown Galleria.
